run_train_text_to_image_xla: run text-to-image finetuning on Stable Diffusion using PyTorch/XLA with SPMD data parallelism
create_train_sd_trainer: create a TrainSD class instance to manage the training loop, optimizer step, and loss computation for XLA devices
save_model_card_xla: save a model card README with training hyperparameters and pipeline usage instructions for the finetuned model
setup_optimizer_unet: setup an AdamW optimizer for the UNet parameters with configurable learning rate, betas, and weight decay
load_dataset_text_image: load a text-to-image dataset from HuggingFace hub or local imagefolder with configurable image and caption columns
